pillar.title: How Foreigners Can Open a Company in Turkey

clusters.title: Types of Companies in Turkey: Limited vs Joint Stock
clusters.gapNote: English guides list company types but rarely turn the choice into a practical decision framework for foreign founders covering capital, share transferability, governance, and investor readiness.

clusters.title: Company Formation Cost and Documents in Turkey
clusters.gapNote: English guides on company formation in Turkey often give a step list without separating mandatory documents from optional professional support or explaining why cost varies by company type, capital, and document route.

clusters.title: Company Formation Lawyer in Turkey: When to Hire
clusters.gapNote: English content explains the formation steps but rarely clarifies what an attorney actually handles, when self-filing is risky, and how a power of attorney is used by non-resident founders.
